chars.SAAD: a Moroccan young man of 25 with short curly black hair and a light beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with a white stripe on the sleeves and dark blue jeans
chars.FRIEND: a Moroccan young man of 25, slim, clean-shaven with a black buzz cut, wearing a red-and-black checked flannel shirt over a white t-shirt and grey joggers
chars.GIRL: a Moroccan young woman of 24 with long dark brown hair in a low ponytail, wearing a pastel pink baker apron over a cream knit sweater and light blue jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small modern laundry shop in a Moroccan neighbourhood (washing machines, folded clothes on shelves). SAAD stands behind the counter, leaning forward and staring with a hopeful smile at the glass shop door, where GIRL walks past outside on the street carrying a big pink cake box, not looking in. Medium shot, both faces visible, warm afternoon light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: GIRL in a small home kitchen in Morocco, concentrating as she pipes cream rosettes on a tall birthday cake, flour on the table, cake stands around. Head-to-waist framing, face visible, soft window light.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of GIRL smiling proudly as she places a small toy doll on top of a colourful personalised birthday cake decorated with painted cartoon drawings, children's party decorations in the background.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: SAAD sitting on a plastic chair at the door of his laundry shop on a Moroccan street, chin on his hand, gazing dreamily down the street with a lovesick smile, little hearts mood, warm golden hour light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Inside the laundry shop: FRIEND laughs and playfully pushes SAAD's shoulder, pointing toward the street as if saying 'go talk to her'; SAAD looks embarrassed, scratching his head, folding a shirt. Medium shot, both faces visible, comic mood.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: SAAD alone in the laundry shop looking worried and unsure, hand on his forehead, imagining something; behind him a softly blurred thought bubble shape showing a woman's silhouette with an engagement ring sparkle (no text, no letters).

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: SAAD and FRIEND sitting side by side on a sofa in a Moroccan living room at night, heads close together, both staring wide-eyed at one smartphone screen held by SAAD (screen glow on their faces, screen content not visible), excited and nervous expressions.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: SAAD standing in a Moroccan family living room with traditional sedari cushions, holding his phone and looking at a wall calendar with one day circled in red, a thoughtful scheming smile on his face, evening lamp light.
